patch_description: Add a mid-circuit mini-sandwich block immediately after the forward CNOT ladder: a two-group RY layer reusing "ry_a"/"ry_b" (following the same interleaved even/odd wire partition already used for the pre-rotation layer) followed by a global RZ on all wires with a new shared parameter "rz_mid". This adds expressivity in the mixing region between the initial encoding rotation and the entangling ring, giving the model an extra nonlinear mixing stage that reuses existing parameters where possible (only one new trainable name "rz_mid" is introduced), which should help separate the hardest validation group (worst_group_margin) without significantly increasing parameter count.
